label: HISTORICAL DEVELOPMENT
question: Can calibrating the probability of three or more goals within match outcomes improve R13 scores? Can the third slot cover a supported higher-total path missed by the first two?
population: Use the signed R30 R13 grids, complete league-phase populations, original decisions and same-fixture market references. Fit independently by competition in the first chronological window and use the middle window to select a rule. The latest dates were previously studied and are historical development evidence.
fit: For the actual outcome in each training fixture, model the observed event of total goals at least three. Use the original within-outcome low-to-high binary probabilities as offsets, and fit one logit offset for draws and one shared by home and away wins. Optimize binary negative log likelihood plus 8 times each offset squared within [-1.25, 1.25], round the offsets to six decimals. At inference adjust both win outcomes and the draw independently and preserve each original outcome mass and relative cell weights within its low or high total group.
arms: Compare original R13 with full score re-ranking at half and full offset. Also compare a separate third-only rule at full offset. Only compare on grids reproducing the original three at zero dose. For third-only, keep the original first two. A new score must have at least three goals, rank fourth through twelfth under the original grid, and belong to an outcome represented by an original first-two score of at most two goals. The original three must omit any three-plus score of that same outcome. The calibrated outcome mass must be at least 0.30 and the within-outcome three-plus probability at least 0.60. Accept the highest adjusted joint-probability new score only when it has at least half the adjusted probability of the original third. Break ties by original rank. All arms retain the original independent WDL and actual-line direction.
selection: Across the full validation population, screen on at least one positive net score metric and no losses in either first hits or three hits. Prefer first hits, three hits, then registered order third-only, half re-ranking, full re-ranking. Retain R13 if none qualify. Report all variants and the single chosen one on the latest dates. Report pregame and observed-outcome-conditional three-plus calibration and Brier scores, mean total goals, original-vs-updated score paths, changes, paired uncertainty by match date, and the same original market reference.
next_check: A selected variant needs positive evaluation net hits on either score metric and no loss in the other before an independently frozen complete later slate. The original posted scores and already registered stage outcomes use their existing first-display ledger.
